<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$zeta</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">int</span> <span class="hl-var">$alpha</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">bool</span> <span class="hl-var">$mid</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">float</span> <span class="hl-var">$beta</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$omega</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            zeta: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'zeta'</span>],
            alpha: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'alpha'</span>],
            mid: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'mid'</span>],
            beta: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'beta'</span>],
            omega: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'omega'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'zeta'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;zeta,
            <span class="hl-str">'alpha'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;alpha,
            <span class="hl-str">'mid'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;mid,
            <span class="hl-str">'beta'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;beta,
            <span class="hl-str">'omega'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;omega,
        ];
    }
}
